pages.title: Shoulder or Heel
pages.text: Turn a safe sprint or short fall into a gear-specific impact.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The pauldron works during sprinting; boots use fall distance. Start from a small safe height against a hostile target. Merely wearing the gear is not enough.
